detail.title: Touch liquid crystal display apparatus
detail.abstract: The invention provides a touch liquid crystal display apparatus, and relates to the technical field of display. The touch liquid crystal display apparatus can effectively improve the situation that the touch liquid crystal display apparatus adopting a full adhesion manner is easy to generate water ripples so as to solve the problem that the display quality is reduced. The touch liquid crystal display apparatus comprises a liquid crystal display module and a package base plate, wherein the liquid crystal display module and the package base plate are adhered together through a first adhesive, a display area of the liquid crystal display module is covered with the first adhesive, a second adhesive is arranged between the liquid crystal display module and the package base plate and is positioned in a non-display area of the liquid crystal display module, and the hardness of the second adhesive is larger than that of the first adhesive. The apparatus is suitable for manufacturing touch liquid crystal display apparatuses.
